Spring 2027 entry is open to Ph.D. applicants only; its Round 1 deadline of 27 September 2026 has passed, with decisions released 8 November 2026 and the semester starting 17 January 2027. KAUST states these dates are tentative and may change based on application volume.

official.status_note: KAUST's 2026-2027 admissions timeline lists applications for Spring 2027 entry as open (Ph.D. only) and the Fall 2027 Round 2 as open since 28 September 2026, with the application deadline on 3 January 2027.

official.application_route: Apply online through the KAUST admissions portal; there is no separate application for the Fellowship, which is awarded automatically to admitted students (except those funded through specific partnerships or external sponsorship)
official.study_mode: Full-time, on-campus; KAUST is a campus university and the Ph.D. full-time workload is twelve credit hours per semester and six in summer
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship or residency requirement is published; KAUST's community spans over 120 nationalities. Saudi applicants may provide a national ID card instead of a passport page, and Saudi nationals meeting lower minimum English scores may be admitted on condition of taking the Academic English Language Communication Course (AELC) in their first semester.
official.international_eligibility: Yes; KAUST states its community includes over 120 nationalities and the language of instruction in its programs is English, with no published nationality restriction
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The degree must be in a subject relevant to the program applied to; programs are offered across 17 subjects (16 for Ph.D.) and not all degree programs offer the M.S./Ph.D. pathway. M.S./Ph.D. and Ph.D. applicants may list faculty members they are most interested in working with, but do not need to contact faculty before applying.
official.research_requirement: A statement of purpose of approximately 750 words covering past work, preparation for the intended field of study, relevant background and interests, academic plans, career objectives and reasons for applying; research ability is further assessed at interview. No separate research proposal is published as a requirement.
official.duration: M.S.: 1.5 years (2 years with thesis); a 36-credit program expected to be completed in three semesters and one summer session. Ph.D.: 4 years, typically completed in eight semesters and four summer sessions. M.S./Ph.D. pathway: 5.5 to 6 years.
official.description: The KAUST Fellowship is designed so admitted graduate students at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia can focus entirely on their studies and research. KAUST publishes that the Fellowship includes full tuition and bench fee coverage, a monthly stipend, base on-campus accommodation, health insurance for students and eligible dependents living on campus, and relocation support, with a total calculated value of between $70k and $80k per year.
official.program_type: University fellowship awarded automatically with graduate admission
official.english_requirement: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in all individual sections (IELTS Online accepted), or TOEFL iBT 5.0 overall with at least 4.5 in all individual sections (KAUST Admissions code 4107; TOEFL Home Edition accepted), or PTE Academic 71 overall with at least 67 in all individual sections, or Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 185 overall with at least 176 in all individual sections. Scores are valid for two years from the test date and only official academic results are accepted. Medium of Instruction certificates, the Duolingo English Test (except for Visiting Student applicants), TOEFL MyBest superscores and IELTS One Skill Retake results are not accepted. A score is not required if the applicant earned a degree through in-person study at an accredited institution in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia or New Zealand, or previously completed a degree taken at KAUST's campus in Thuwal; degrees completed by distance learning, satellite campuses, joint programs or branch institutions outside those countries do not qualify. An application may be submitted without a score but the minimum must be met before enrolment. Saudi nationals and Ph.D. students with IELTS 6.5 overall (at least 6.0 in all sections), TOEFL 4.5 (at least 4.0 in all sections), PTE Academic 64 (at least 61 in all sections) or Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 176 (at least 169 in all sections) may be admitted on condition of taking the Academic English Language Communication Course (AELC) in their first semester.

applicant_utility.summary: The Fellowship is automatic with admission, so there is no separate scholarship application and no application fee; your admissions application is the whole process. The actionable window right now is Fall 2027 Round 2, which closes 3 January 2027 for M.S., M.S./Ph.D. and Ph.D. applicants, while Spring 2027 entry is Ph.D.-only and its Round 1 deadline has already passed. Line up three referees with institutional email addresses before you start the form, because reference requests fire automatically the moment you enter their details and late references can stall review. Attach a valid English test score if you can: applying without one is allowed, but admission is competitive and the minimum must be met before enrolment.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants with a relevant bachelor's degree (M.S. entry) or a relevant master's degree (Ph.D. entry), a GPA of at least 3.0/4.0 and realistically above 3.3-3.5, and a clear research direction in one of KAUST's science, engineering and mathematics subjects.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your chosen subject actually offers the M.S./Ph.D. pathway if that is your intended route, since not all programs do
Secure three referees' permission and their academic or professional email addresses before opening the application form
Book IELTS, TOEFL, PTE or Cambridge early enough that a valid score (within two years) is in hand before 3 January 2027
Request transcripts from every institution attended including the grading scale, and start any certified English translation well ahead of the deadline
Draft the roughly 750-word statement of purpose around your reasons for choosing this specific KAUST program
Check that your passport page copy is unobscured and that your name matches across CV, transcripts and passport
common_rejection_risks: Referee contact details using personal email addresses, which KAUST does not accept
References arriving more than seven calendar days after the deadline, delaying the application's progress
Transcripts missing the institution's grading scale, or missing records from a previously attended institution
An undeclared Professional Master's degree on a Ph.D. application, since it is not regarded as directly equivalent
Applying to more than one academic program in the same year, or assuming the application can be edited after submission
Relying on a Medium of Instruction certificate or a Duolingo score, neither of which KAUST accepts
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: English proficiency test fees (KAUST states these are not covered), any additional fee for a requested housing upgrade, and personal spending beyond the stipend; KAUST publishes that students spend on average around $1,320 per month, which the Fellowship stipend is stated to more than cover.
document_audit: A partial transcript is acceptable at application, but a final official transcript must reach the Office of Admissions directly from your awarding institution before you arrive
Non-English transcripts need both the original-language document and a certified English translation uploaded together, and translation costs are your responsibility
References must come from the referees themselves through the admissions system; uploading letters yourself does not substitute
The passport copy must show picture and personal details unobscured, and Saudi applicants may use a national ID card instead
Test scores you upload are treated as unofficial and will be verified during the admissions process
alerts: You can only submit one application at a time and one academic program per year, and you cannot change the application after submission unless KAUST contacts you for more information
If accepted you have a limited time to respond to secure the place, or the decision may be withdrawn
KAUST labels its published admission dates as tentative and subject to change based on application volume, so re-check the timeline page before relying on a date

Students sponsored by other universities, companies or external funding sources will not receive the Fellowship in addition to that sponsorship, and any supplementary support for tuition, relocation or living costs must be declared to the University
M.S. and M.S./Ph.D. applicants cannot use the Spring 2027 round, which is Ph.D.-only, so target the Fall 2027 deadline of 3 January 2027
All admission decisions are final and will not be reconsidered, and KAUST does not provide individual feedback on applications
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit through the KAUST admissions portal before the round deadline; the Admissions team checks documents, a faculty review committee ranks and shortlists applicants, shortlisted candidates attend an online interview, and the outcome arrives by email on the round's notification date.
